movie.title: The Priest: Thanksgiving Massacre
movie.overview: A family gather to spend Thanksgiving at an isolated cabin, unaware that the site has a horrific history of murder and cannibalism and that the Priest responsible did not rest in peace. Now they are on the menu for Thanksgiving dinner.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a family gathers at an isolated cabin for Thanksgiving, they become the main course for a vengeful, cannibalistic Priest back from the dead.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A family travels to a secluded cabin in the woods expecting a peaceful Thanksgiving holiday together. Unbeknownst to them, the land carries a dark, blood-soaked history of gruesome murders and cannibalism. The depraved Priest responsible for the past atrocities has returned from the grave to claim new victims. Trapped in the remote wilderness, the family must fight for survival to avoid becoming dinner.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Looking to reconnect over the holiday weekend, a family retreats to a quiet, isolated cabin nestled deep in the forest for Thanksgiving. As they settle in, they remain completely unaware that the picturesque land hides a nightmare past marked by ritualistic murder and human consumption. The sadistic Priest who orchestrated the original killings was never truly defeated, and his dark spirit continues to haunt the grounds. As night falls, strange and disturbing occurrences begin to terrorize the family, cutting off their means of communication and escape. One by one, the family members find themselves hunted by the resurrected religious fanatic and his unrelenting hunger. Terrifying confrontations force them to confront the terrifying history of the cabin while using whatever tools they can find to stay alive. The battle for survival escalates into a brutal fight against an unholy force that views them solely as the main course. With no help in sight, the remaining survivors must overcome their sheer terror to defeat the immortal evil before the feast is complete.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Priest: Thanksgiving Massacre is a terrifying holiday horror film that transforms a traditional family gathering into a violent battle for survival. Set in an isolated wilderness cabin, the story follows a family seeking a peaceful Thanksgiving getaway, only to realize they have stumbled onto the cursed grounds of a horrific past. Decades earlier, a mad Priest conducted brutal killings and cannibalistic acts on the site, leaving behind a legacy of terror. Now, as the Priest's vengeful spirit resurrects to stalk fresh prey, the unsuspecting family finds themselves trapped with no escape. Blending dark atmosphere with relentless suspense, the film delivers a chilling tale of survival against a dark force that refuses to stay buried.

story_structure.climax: The trapped family reaches a desperate stand against the murderous Priest in a high-stakes, terrifying battle for survival.
story_structure.conflict: Dark sinister forces begin to surface as the family unknowingly treads upon ground cursed by a historic legacy of violent murder and cannibalism.
story_structure.resolution: The immediate nightmare reaches its terrifying end, leaving the aftermath of the ordeal and the lasting impact of the cabin's dark history to settle.
story_structure.introduction: A family arrives at an isolated cabin, eager to celebrate a peaceful Thanksgiving holiday together in remote surroundings.
story_structure.risingAction: Eerie occurrences and mounting threats escalate, trapping the isolated family as they come to realize the resurrected undead Priest is systematically hunting them for a grotesque holiday feast.
